title: (To be deprecated) Create Legacy Smart+ Lead Generation Campaigns
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create Smart+ Lead Generation Campaigns. Based on your preference for the optimization location, you can create a Smart+ Lead Generation Campaign with optimization location as Instant Form or Website. For detailed instructions on creating each type, refer to their respective sections: "Create a Smart+ Lead Generation Campaign with optimization location as Instant Form" and "Create a Smart+ Lead Generation Campaign with optimization location as Website". # Create a Smart+ Lead Generation Campaign with optimization location as Instant Form ## Prerequisites Ensure that you have an existing Instant Form within your ad account. - To create an Instant Form, use [Instant Page Editor SDK](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740307202170881) and set `businessType` to `1`. Then call [/page/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1820826387779586) to get the page ID of the Instant Form through `page_id`. ## Steps Note that the following requirements must be met. To find a complete list of parameters, see [/campaign/spc/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1767334204047362). > **Note**
> Smart+ Lead Generation ad groups cannot be used in [/split_test/create/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1742666471475201) to create split test groups.
Setting Requirement Parameter How to configure the parameter
Advertising objective Lead generation objective_type LEAD_GENERATION
Campaign setup Smart+ Campaign N/A N/A
Campaigns created through /campaign/spc/create/ are all Smart+ Campaigns.
Campaign name Specify a valid name campaign_name Pass a valid value
Special ad categories
(Optional)		 Enabled or disabled

Note: This setting is only supported for advertisers who are registered in the US or Canada.

 special_industries Pass valid values or not passed
Campaign Budget Optimization (CBO) N/A

Note: CBO is enabled by default for Smart+ Campaigns.

 N/A N/A

Note: If you retrieve Smart+ Campaigns via /campaign/get/, the returned budget_optimize_on will be true.
Optimization location (Promotion type) Instant Form promotion_type LEAD_GENERATION
promotion_target_type INSTANT_PAGE
Deep funnel optimization
(Optional)		 Enabled or disabled

With deep funnel optimization, you can select a secondary event alongside the primary optimization event, which can help improve campaign effectiveness.		 deep_funnel_optimization_status
deep_funnel_event_source
deep_funnel_event_source_id
deep_funnel_optimization_event
  • To enable deep funnel optimization, set deep_funnel_optimization_status to ON and pass deep_funnel_event_source, deep_funnel_event_source_id, and deep_funnel_optimization_event.
  • To disable deep funnel optimization, set deep_funnel_optimization_status to OFF or leave deep_funnel_optimization_status unspecified. Do not pass deep_funnel_event_source, deep_funnel_event_source_id, and deep_funnel_optimization_event.

Note:

  • Deep funnel optimization with CRM events is currently an allowlist-only feature. If you would like to access it, please contact your TikTok representative.
  • Deep funnel optimization with Pixel or Offline events is generally available.
Optimization goal Form submission optimization_goal LEAD_GENERATION
Placement TikTok placement including search result placement_type PLACEMENT_TYPE_NORMAL
placements ["PLACEMENT_TIKTOK"]

Note: The Automatic Search Placement is enabled by default.

(Optional)		 Enabled or disabled comment_disabled Pass valid values or not passed

  • 18+

  • 18+
  • 25+
Audience targeting

(Optional)		 Enabled or disabled excluded_audience_ids Pass valid values or not passed

Schedule type Any of the following types:
  • Run campaign continuously after the scheduled start time
  • Run campaign between the scheduled start time and end time

schedule_start_time
schedule_end_time
  • To run the campaign continuously after the scheduled start time, set schedule_type to SCHEDULE_FROM_NOW and specify schedule_start_time. Do not pass schedule_end_time.
  • To run the campaign between the scheduled start time and end time, set schedule_type to SCHEDULE_START_END and specify both schedule_start_time and schedule_end_time.
Bid strategy Any of the following types:
  • Maximum Delivery
  • Cost Cap (or Target CPA)
 bid_type
conversion_bid_price		 Set bid_type to BID_TYPE_CUSTOM or BID_TYPE_NO_BID.
  • If bid_type is BID_TYPE_CUSTOM, pass conversion_bid_price at the same time.
bid_price
deep_bid_type
roas_bid		 Not passed
Billing event oCPM billing_event OCPM
Identity Any of the following options:
  • Authorized User
  • TikTok User
  • TikTok Account User in Business Center
 identity_type Any of the following values:
  • AUTH_CODE
  • TT_USER
  • BC_AUTH_TT

Note: Pass values to identity_type and identity_id within the media_info object.
identity_id Pass a valid value.
To get the list of identities under your ad account, use /identity/get/.
identity_authorized_bc_id Pass a valid value when identity_type is BC_AUTH_TT
Destination Instant Form page_list Specify the page ID of an Instant Form.
  • To obtain the page ID of an Instant Form, set business_type to LEAD_GEN in /page/get/.
  • To create an Instant Form, use Instant Page Editor SDK and set businessType to 1.
landing_page_urls Not passed
Ad creative
  • For Authorized User identity, or Spark Ads PULL with TikTok User or TikTok Account User in Business Center identity, specify one to 30 TikTok posts.
 video_info
image_info
title_list
tiktok_item_id
  • If identity_type within the media_info object is TT_USER or BC_AUTH_TT, you can create the campaign through Spark Ads PULL:
    • Spark Ads PULL: Specify one to 30 TikTok posts through tiktok_item_id. Do not pass video_info, image_info, and title_list.
    To learn more about Spark Ads, see Create Spark Ads.
  • If identity_type within the media_info object is AUTH_CODE, specify one to 30 TikTok posts through tiktok_item_id. Do not pass video_info, image_info, and title_list.
Interactive add-ons
(Optional)		 Disabled or enabled with the following type:
  • Display Card
 card_list Not passed or specify the ID of the following creative portfolio type:
  • Display Card

To create a creative portfolio, use /creative/portfolio/create/.
  • To learn about how to get the ID of a Display Card portfolio, see Cards.
Call to action Dynamic call_to_action_id Specify a valid value.

To learn about how to create Dynamic CTAs, see Dynamic CTAs.
call_to_action_list Not passed
